def solve(T):

        if rows or cols: sep.add(v)
    objs=[v for v,_ in order if v!=most and v not in sep]
    o=max(objs,key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in T))
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if T[i][j]==o]
    line=None; ax=None

        if fullr or fullc:
            if len(fullr)==h: line=v;ax=0;break
            if len(fullc)==w: line=v;ax=1;break
    out=[r[:] for r in T]
    rs=[i for i,j in cells]; cs=[j for i,j in cells]

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# Re-derive rule from all five demos. Summarize each diff:
def summarize(name):
    I=G[f'Demo pair {name} input']; O=G[f'Demo pair {name} output']
    h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in I for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    lr=None;lc=None;ax=None
    for j in range(w):
        if len(set(I[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and I[0][j]!=bg: lr,lc,ax=I[0][j],j,'v';break
    else:
        for i in range(h):
            if len(set(I[i]))==1 and I[i][0]!=bg: lr,lc,ax=I[i][0],i,'h';break
    diffs=[(i,j,I[i][j],O[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if I[i][j]!=O[i][j]]
    drows=sorted(set(i for i,j,v,w in diffs)); dcols=sorted(set(j for i,j,v,w in diffs))
    ocells=[(i,j) for i,j in [(a,b) for a,b in [(i,j) for i,j,v,w in diffs]] if True]
    # object color = colors involved other than bg,line,8
    colors=sorted({v for i,j,v,w in diffs}-{bg,lc,8})
    objs=set(zip(*[(i,j) for i,j,v,w in diffs]))
    rs=[i for i,j in objs]; cs=[j for i,j in objs]
    print(f'--- demo {name}: bg={bg} line={lr} col={lc} axis={ax} diff cells {len(diffs)} obj color(s) {colors} object bbox rows {min(rs)}-{max(rs)} cols {min(cs)}-{max(cs)} changed rows {drows[0]} ... {drows[-1]}')
for n in (1,2,3,4,5):
    summarize(n)

        # shift along row: new left edge = adjacent to barrier
        anchor = newpos

def f(T):
    h,w=len(T),len(T[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in T for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    axis=None; Lr=None
    for j in range(w):
        if len(set(T[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and T[0][j]!=bg:
            Lr=j; axis='v'; break
    else:
        for i in range(h):
            if len(set(T[i]))==1 and T[i][0]!=bg:
                Lr=i; axis='h'
    mask=[(i,j,T[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)]
    mask=[m for m in mask if m[2]!=bg and not ((axis=='v' and m[1]==Lr) or (axis=='h' and m[0]==Lr))]
    o=set(mask)
    rs=[m[0] for m in o]; cs=[m[1] for m in o]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # move toward line so near edge becomes adjacent to line. Line at Lr. Object spans cols/rows rs/cs.
    if axis=='v':  # vertical line -> shift columns horizontally toward Lr
        ncol=min(cs) if min(cs)>Lr else max(cs)
        sh=(Lr+1)-ncol if ncol>Lr else (Lr-1)-ncol
        faref=max(cs)+sh
        for i,j,v in o: out[i][j+sh]=v
        # 8s: below object rows... For demo3 the vertical 8 col is at far edge = max(cs)+sh? no, at Lr - min? Let's just fill full column above+beyond. Actually from demos 4,5 with horizontal lines 8s fill entire row below object. With vertical line 8s fill entire grid column at faref. Demo3: 8s at col faref, all rows.
        for i in range(h): out[i][faref+1]=8
    else:  # horizontal line -> shift rows vertically toward Lr
        nrow=min(rs) if min(rs)>Lr else max(rs)
        sh=(Lr+1)-nrow if nrow>Lr else (Lr-1)-nrow
        faref=max(rs)+sh
        for i,j,v in o: out[i+sh][j]=v
        for i in range(faref+1, h): out[i]=[8]*w
    return out
